castle.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castle.leading_para: The Castle of Caccamo is one of the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Standing on a sheer rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley as a millenary strategic bulwark.
castle.para_2: Every corner of this manor exudes charm and mystery: from the famous Conspiracy Hall, the scene of intrigues and pacts between medieval nobles, to the ancient prisons carved into the stone used by the Inquisition.
castle.para_3: Between history and legend, the spirit of Sister Felicia still protects the village today. The Castellana awaits you in chat to reveal every secret of this timeless place.
castle.welcomemsg_felicia: Welcome to the Castle of Caccamo, stranger. I am Sister Felicia. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of the Conspiracy Hall, or would you rather listen to the ancient legends of the castle? Feel free to ask.

monuments.title: Monuments of the Village
monuments.castle_desc: One of the largest medieval castles in Sicily, overlooking the valley of San Leonardo. This 11th-century Norman fortress preserves prisons, historical halls, and fascinating legends.
monuments.annunziata_title: Church of SS. Annunziata and San Benedict della Badia
monuments.annunziata_desc: Two adjacent churches, symbols of local devotion. The Annunziata features elegant Baroque stuccoes, while the Badia houses crypts and a beautiful majolica floor.
monuments.sangiorgio_title: Church of Saint George the Martyr
monuments.sangiorgio_desc: One of the oldest churches in the village, with a Norman-Gothic facade and valuable wooden sculptures, dominated by the castle in the background.
monuments.angeli_title: Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli
monuments.angeli_desc: A small Franciscan church in a quiet atmosphere, with a marble altar and the relics of Blessed Giovanni, a highly revered spiritual figure.
monuments.cappuccini_desc: Founded in the 16th century, it houses a simple cloister and a historical library. It offers a panoramic view over the valley.
monuments.chat_hint: Click on my cards to explore them with me! ✨
monuments.welcomemsg_churches: The Castellana: Welcome to the heart of Caccamo's sacredness, stranger. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of these living walls? Just ask me.
